8c2bb41a5eb9.en: "So that's why you trust him. Who's the boss?" Clodoveu smiles. "I could tell you all about him, but you won't believe it until you meet him." "Okay—so how should I defend myself?" Wilson laughs. "Even I know that's a stupid question! Oh, wait—" Clodoveu: "I knew you'd come around. Harry, you've got a Bagarisa's power. Nobody else has it! Use it! Abuse it!"
8c2bb41a5eb9.t: “Jadi sebab tulah kau percayakan dia. Siapa bos?” Clodoveu tersenyum. “Aku boleh cerita semua pasal dia, tapi kau takkan percaya sampai kau jumpa dia.” “Okey—jadi macam mana aku patut pertahankan diri?” Wilson ketawa. “Aku pun tahu tu soalan bodoh! Oh, kejap—” Clodoveu: “Aku tahu kau akan faham. Harry, kau ada kuasa Bagarisa. Tak ada orang lain ada! Guna! Salah guna!”

8c5aa6b7fd81.en: Harry #10 and the others haul a load through the forest
8c5aa6b7fd81.t: Harry #10 dan yang lain mengangkut muatan melalui hutan

8d54b5f2f0cc.en: Harry looks at Clodoveu. "Go all out." Harry tries with all his might, and manages only a weak flicker of fire. The boss grabs one of his hands, snaps the bone and rips it off at the forearm. Harry screams as the fire flickers in and out, bursting up his arm and into his head, filling his mohawk.
8d54b5f2f0cc.t: Harry memandang Clodoveu. “Habis-habisan.” Harry mencuba sekuat hati, dan hanya mampu menghasilkan kelipan api yang lemah. Bos itu mencekak sebelah tangannya, mematahkan tulangnya dan merentapnya putus di lengan bawah. Harry menjerit ketika api berkelip-kelip, meledak naik lengannya dan ke kepalanya, memenuhi mohawknya.

8f0326989ba4.en: Katsumi holds her hands. "All right, cut it out! Harry is not a savior. He's a nobody like us, and what do nobodies do? They save themselves!"
8f0326989ba4.t: Katsumi memegang tangannya. “Sudah, hentikan! Harry bukan penyelamat. Dia orang biasa macam kita, dan apa orang biasa buat? Mereka selamatkan diri sendiri!”

90a5c2bfed4e.en: "Remember what I told you all yesterday." In near unison: "Yes." Eiri pulls Sora in front of her. "No more secrets, okay?" "Yes." "See you all for brunch."
90a5c2bfed4e.t: “Ingat apa aku beritahu korang semalam.” Hampir serentak: “Ya.” Eiri menarik Sora ke depannya. “Tak ada rahsia lagi, okey?” “Ya.” “Jumpa semua masa makan tengah hari awal.”

91bd37922549.en: His arm slumps to the ground, and so does his head. Harry Sanbi dies in the middle of butt-fuck nowhere.
91bd37922549.t: Lengannya terkulai ke tanah, begitu juga kepalanya. Harry Sanbi mati di tengah-tengah ceruk hutan entah ke mana celaka.

93c300fbafd4.en: Harry #10 and the bandits at breakfast

93cd596ed9f9.en: From far off, he hears children playing and people going about their lives. He stands still: he wants to go, and at the same time he doesn't. What if Eori finds me? What if the Red Winga find me? He slips back into the forest.
93cd596ed9f9.t: Dari jauh, dia mendengar kanak-kanak bermain dan orang menjalani hidup. Dia berdiri kaku: dia mahu pergi, dan pada masa yang sama dia tidak mahu. Macam mana kalau Eori jumpa aku? Macam mana kalau Red Winga jumpa aku? Dia menyelinap kembali ke dalam hutan.

93e2586342c2.en: Something moves on his left. "AGRHGHRHHRHGR!" A toothy mouth flashes in front of him and takes him to the ground, and he feels warmth again: his own blood, squirting from his neck. I don't wanna die! I don't wanna die! He flails and hits the beast right in the eyes.
93e2586342c2.t: Sesuatu bergerak di sebelah kirinya. “AGRHGHRHHRHGR!” Mulut penuh gigi berkelip di depannya dan menjatuhkannya ke tanah, dan dia rasa hangat semula: darahnya sendiri, memancut dari lehernya. Aku tak nak mati! Aku tak nak mati! Dia meronta-ronta dan memukul makhluk itu tepat di matanya.

943831949f7f.en: Itagiba, Neferteri, Huneo and Eiri on Harry
943831949f7f.t: Itagiba, Neferteri, Huneo dan Eiri tentang Harry

96cf5c042f93.en: Huneo straightens himself. "I shall report this violation—" Itagiba sighs. "C'mon, Huneo! Cut us some slack here!" "Absolutely not. I bid my king and queen a good day!"
96cf5c042f93.t: Huneo membetulkan dirinya. “Saya akan melaporkan pelanggaran ini—” Itagiba mengeluh. “Alahai, Huneo! Longgarkan sikit untuk kami!” “Sama sekali tidak. Selamat siang, tuanku raja dan permaisuri!”

97d9c1da624c.en: Huneo: "Arranging the ceremony. I'd like it done in two days." Itagiba: "That soon? There won't be enough time to advertise it." Neferteri stays silent, still suspicious. Huneo points at his massive list of reforms. "There's no time to be jerking around."
97d9c1da624c.t: Huneo: “Mengatur upacara. Saya mahu ia diadakan dalam dua hari.” Itagiba: “Secepat itu? Tak cukup masa untuk mengiklankannya.” Neferteri terus diam, masih curiga. Huneo menunjuk senarai pembaharuannya yang panjang berjela. “Tiada masa untuk main-main.”

98309eae02ca.en: His vision is desaturated, the colors flat, but he sees a wavering, ghostly flame in the oppressive shape of a human, far off in the forest. No thought in his head but the raw, obscenely loud urge to kill. With every step, his hands tickle as a massive fire builds up his arms.
98309eae02ca.t: Penglihatannya pudar warna, warnanya mendatar, tetapi dia nampak api seperti hantu yang beralun dalam bentuk manusia yang menekan, jauh di dalam hutan. Tiada fikiran dalam kepalanya selain desakan mentah yang bingit melampau untuk membunuh. Dengan setiap langkah, tangannya geli ketika api besar terkumpul naik ke lengannya.

9864a43ca00d.en: "Apprentice Kibe." "What?" "My guards were investigating what happened that day, and we came across one more fact everyone glossed over: nobody in the slums knows Harry." "I don't either. I lost all my memories of that day, and of several weeks before it." "I figured as much. Unfortunate. Thank you for your time. Now get on with the tasks I gave you." Kibe walks out.
9864a43ca00d.t: “Perantis Kibe.” “Apa?” “Pengawal saya menyiasat apa yang berlaku hari itu, dan kami terjumpa satu lagi fakta yang semua orang terlepas pandang: tiada siapa di setinggan kenal Harry.” “Aku pun tak kenal. Aku hilang semua ingatan hari tu, dan beberapa minggu sebelumnya.” “Saya dah agak. Malang sekali. Terima kasih atas masa tuan. Sekarang teruskan tugas yang saya beri.” Kibe keluar.

99245b29d97b.en: Itanema: "I did just like I told you." Neferteri: "And did Eiri's behavior match my expectations?" "It did. Now where's Sinoi? He hasn't contacted me in weeks!"
99245b29d97b.t: Itanema: “Saya buat tepat seperti yang saya beritahu tuanku.” Neferteri: “Dan adakah kelakuan Eiri sepadan dengan jangkaan beta?” “Ya. Sekarang di mana Sinoi? Dia tak hubungi saya berminggu-minggu!”

9925c8a7522e.en: Kibe flips through it: Gabiro's cryptic scribbles cover everything. "So, did you crack any of his code?" "Of course not. Otherwise we'd have made all his research public, for the good of the kingdom." "I thought so. Good luck with that." He puts the book back and walks off.
9925c8a7522e.t: Kibe menyelak-nyelaknya: contengan samar Gabiro memenuhi segalanya. “Jadi, kau dah pecahkan mana-mana kod dia?” “Sudah tentu tidak. Kalau tidak, kita dah umumkan semua penyelidikannya, untuk kebaikan kerajaan.” “Dah agak dah. Semoga berjaya.” Dia meletakkan buku itu semula dan beredar.

9a62451017d6.en: Hiromi and Yacamim at a small roadside bar between Forway and Sanbi
9a62451017d6.t: Hiromi dan Yacamim di sebuah bar kecil tepi jalan antara Forway dan Sanbi

9c08aa66d9ce.en: Marcus: "Shut up." He grabs Harry by the mohawk, yanks his head back and slits his throat. Harry gurgles in agony as the wound heals almost instantly, leaving him panting and weak. Clodoveu: "Was that really necessary?" Marcus raises the knife again. "That was for burning my tongue alive, you motherfucker—who the fuck are you?"
9c08aa66d9ce.t: Marcus: “Diam.” Dia mencekak Harry pada rambut mohawknya, merentap kepalanya ke belakang dan mengelar lehernya. Harry berdeguk dalam derita ketika luka itu sembuh hampir serta-merta, meninggalkannya tercungap dan lemah. Clodoveu: “Perlu ke tu?” Marcus mengangkat pisau lagi. “Itu sebab bakar lidah aku hidup-hidup, kau anak haram—siapa celaka kau ni?”

9c1a6cdee93e.en: Clodoveu: "Harry, want to duel Marcus?" Harry wants to kick Marcus's face in, but the memory of being killed by Maiara sends a shiver down his spine. Marcus smiles. "You fat pussy." He takes a big bite, chews and spits it at Harry; bits of Bagarisa meat and spit run down his face. A flame lights on Harry's fingers.
9c1a6cdee93e.t: Clodoveu: “Harry, nak berlawan dengan Marcus?” Harry mahu menyepak muka Marcus, tetapi ingatan dibunuh Maiara membuat bulu romanya meremang. Marcus tersenyum. “Kau pantat gemuk penakut.” Dia menggigit besar, mengunyah dan meludahkannya kepada Harry; serpihan daging Bagarisa dan ludah mengalir di mukanya. Api menyala di jari Harry.

9d2ba74e4118.en: Author's to-do: have someone in the Wozen party bond with Harry over the things he still remembers, like days having 24 hours. Something to bond over.
9d2ba74e4118.t: Senarai tugas pengarang: biar seseorang dalam kumpulan Wozen rapat dengan Harry melalui perkara yang dia masih ingat, seperti sehari ada 24 jam. Sesuatu untuk merapatkan mereka.

9d717c6e176c.en: The room goes silent, then fills with murmurs about what needs to happen. One confident voice in the back cuts through with a sharp clearing of the throat: "According to Sanbi law, only an apprentice can replace a courtroom scientist." It's Huneo.
9d717c6e176c.t: Bilik itu sunyi, kemudian dipenuhi bisikan tentang apa yang perlu dilakukan. Satu suara yakin di belakang memotong dengan berdehem tajam: “Menurut undang-undang Sanbi, hanya perantis boleh menggantikan saintis istana.” Itu Huneo.

9df679131884.en: He's against the same tree, his shirt in tatters. Everything is back where it belongs, but he's even thinner now, and so are two of the Bagarisas. They healed me! He hugs the two underweight ones. "I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I didn't know!" Understanding oinks, if such a thing can be inferred.
9df679131884.t: Dia bersandar pada pokok yang sama, bajunya compang-camping. Semuanya kembali di tempat asal, tetapi dia lebih kurus sekarang, begitu juga dua ekor Bagarisa. Mereka sembuhkan aku! Dia memeluk dua ekor yang kurus itu. “Maaf! Maaf! Aku tak tahu!” Dengusan memahami, kalau benda macam tu boleh disimpulkan.

9f34e9cf1a95.en: Maiara blushes and glances at Eori. "I'm not lazy!" Aurora: "And everyone knows your accomplishments too, Princess Eori. I can tell you're just burned out from your research. Give it some time, maybe travel a bit to get your mojo back!" She puts her hands on Maiara's broad shoulders. "Maybe cheer on Princess Maiara's tournament?" Maiara keeps glancing at Eori with an attention-seeking smile, and Eori smiles a little.
9f34e9cf1a95.t: Maiara tersipu dan mengerling Eori. “Aku tak malas!” Aurora: “Dan semua orang tahu pencapaian tuan puteri juga, Puteri Eori. Saya boleh nampak tuan puteri cuma keletihan dengan penyelidikan. Beri masa, mungkin mengembara sikit untuk dapatkan semangat balik!” Dia meletakkan tangan di bahu Maiara yang lebar. “Mungkin bersorak untuk kejohanan Puteri Maiara?” Maiara terus mengerling Eori dengan senyuman meminta perhatian, dan Eori tersenyum sedikit.

9fc7d713ad1b.en: Harry lights the fost stone, and the Bagarisas all flee outside, spooked; he tries to play with them, but they won't come back.
9fc7d713ad1b.t: Harry menyalakan fost stone, dan semua Bagarisa lari keluar, terkejut; dia cuba bermain dengan mereka, tetapi mereka tidak mahu kembali.

9fcc73db3d40.en: They still stink, but not so bad anymore; maybe his nose stopped working, but who cares. He feels amazing comfort and protection: the cold wind now feels like an A/C breeze keeping a cozy blanket just right.
9fcc73db3d40.t: Mereka masih busuk, tetapi tidak seteruk tadi; mungkin hidungnya dah tak berfungsi, tapi siapa peduli. Dia rasa selesa dan terlindung luar biasa: angin sejuk kini terasa seperti angin penghawa dingin yang mengekalkan selimut yang nyaman pada tahap yang betul.

a019df1b1b3f.en: Harry #9-B wakes up tied in a basement, to a splash of cold water
a019df1b1b3f.t: Harry #9-B bangun terikat di ruang bawah tanah, disimbah air sejuk

a06c34b34fef.en: On top of her, laughing: "So that's what you can really do? Pathetic! Try harder!" He slaps her across the face. "You should've gone for a left kick instead of flailing your arms around. Now it's time for my payment." He grabs her small hips to turn her over, and she puts her hand on his. He pauses. "I haven't shown you what I can really do yet. Let me do the work." "Finally accepting your fate? All right. What are we doing, then?" "Just lie down. Let me take you somewhere far away."
a06c34b34fef.t: Di atasnya, ketawa: “Jadi itu saja yang kau betul-betul mampu? Menyedihkan! Cuba lebih kuat!” Dia menampar mukanya. “Kau patut sepak kiri dan bukannya kibas-kibas tangan. Sekarang masa untuk bayaran aku.” Dia mencengkam pinggul kecilnya untuk menterbalikkannya, dan Katsumi meletakkan tangan di atas tangannya. Dia berhenti. “Aku belum tunjuk apa aku betul-betul mampu. Biar aku buat kerja.” “Akhirnya terima nasib kau? Okey. Jadi kita nak buat apa?” “Baring saja. Biar aku bawa kau ke tempat yang jauh.”

a09c4cdba0dd.en: "Let's do that, then. Let's go get the approval. Everyone else, just go already." "Not so easy. You need to write a letter summarizing all my qualities, and why I'm the one." Kibe groans. "How do I write this letter?" "I can show you."
a09c4cdba0dd.t: “Jom buat macam tu. Jom pergi dapatkan kelulusan. Yang lain, pergi sajalah.” “Tak semudah itu. Tuan perlu tulis surat yang merumuskan semua kelebihan saya, dan kenapa saya orangnya.” Kibe mengerang. “Macam mana nak tulis surat ni?” “Saya boleh tunjukkan.”

a27d7324d3a6.en: She remembers signing the contract: she was so eager to sign it, and now she remembers her sister was just playing along for her sake. She cries. "I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'm gonna come get you!" A howl, not so far off, sends a chill through her. She pulls her fost lamp closer.
a27d7324d3a6.t: Dia teringat menandatangani kontrak: dia begitu bersemangat menandatanganinya, dan sekarang dia ingat adiknya cuma ikut sama demi dirinya. Dia menangis. “Maafkan aku. Maafkan aku. Aku akan datang ambil kau!” Satu lolongan, tidak begitu jauh, membuatnya seram sejuk. Dia menarik lampu fostnya lebih dekat.

a386ab5c6fad.en: Katsumi looks for a way out

a3872617ec62.en: Alone, Neferteri closes her eyes. This should further stabilize the situation. Princess Eori. Daughter. Why must you keep acting this way? How should I proceed? How can I speed up the healing?
a3872617ec62.t: Seorang diri, Neferteri memejamkan mata. Ini sepatutnya menstabilkan lagi keadaan. Puteri Eori. Anakanda. Kenapa anakanda terus berkelakuan begini? Bagaimana beta patut meneruskan? Bagaimana beta boleh mempercepatkan penyembuhan?

a7943c4dae2f.en: Kibe and Huneo meet with Neferteri, Itagiba and Eiri
a7943c4dae2f.t: Kibe dan Huneo bertemu Neferteri, Itagiba dan Eiri

a7fc6561e1a7.en: Nina reads the contract to Eori, with Neferteri's help
a7fc6561e1a7.t: Nina membacakan kontrak kepada Eori, dengan bantuan Neferteri

a8abfc1c6724.en: Neferteri closes her eyes, thinking. "Might we see this evidence?" "I've handed it to the captains to look into. Suffice it to say, I believe some of those field trips were actually used to hide things somewhere." "If your assumption is true, that would be a grave mistake on his part."
a8abfc1c6724.t: Neferteri memejamkan mata, berfikir. “Bolehkah kami lihat bukti ini?” “Saya dah serahkan kepada para kapten untuk disiasat. Cukuplah dikatakan, saya percaya sebahagian lawatan lapangan itu sebenarnya digunakan untuk menyembunyikan sesuatu di suatu tempat.” “Jika andaianmu benar, itu kesilapan besar di pihaknya.”

a92760957229.en: The maids go their ways. Eiri hugs Sora. "Let's go home and take a shower?" A tingle runs through Sora; she turns red. "No wonder you can't find a boyfriend. When Harry's found, you really should wash his back." Sora gets even redder and starts slipping past Eiri, ready to flee. Eiri grabs her. "Ah-ah. You're not running anymore, 'cause you're mine to play with."
a92760957229.t: Para pembantu rumah pergi ke haluan masing-masing. Eiri memeluk Sora. “Jom balik dan mandi?” Satu getaran menjalar dalam diri Sora; mukanya merah. “Patutlah kau tak jumpa teman lelaki. Bila Harry dijumpai, kau memang patut gosok belakang dia.” Sora lebih merah dan mula menyelinap melepasi Eiri, bersedia lari. Eiri menangkapnya. “Ah-ah. Kau dah tak boleh lari, sebab kau mainan aku.”

aa1a0c45da75.en: Kozaku's arm flies into Marcus's gut and rips through him, lifting him off the ground; Marcus pukes his guts out. As his body falls toward Kozaku, a knife appears in his hand and lands right on top of Kozaku's head, piercing his brain.
aa1a0c45da75.t: Lengan Kozaku melayang ke perut Marcus dan merobeknya tembus, mengangkatnya dari tanah; Marcus muntah sepuas-puasnya. Ketika badannya jatuh ke arah Kozaku, sebilah pisau muncul di tangannya dan mendarat tepat di atas kepala Kozaku, menembusi otaknya.

aa3e2baa3b2f.en: "I guess payback's a bitch?" "A bitch and a half. That's for—something in the distance. I can't quite make it out—oh. It's a Fatupari. Never mind, as long as it doesn't come too close." "Fatupari?" "A big-ass snake." "So that's a Fatupari. The Bagarisas and I killed one—and ate it."
aa3e2baa3b2f.t: “Rasanya balasan memang celaka?” “Celaka setengah mati. Itu untuk—ada sesuatu di kejauhan. Aku tak nampak jelas—oh. Fatupari. Tak apa, asalkan ia tak datang terlalu dekat.” “Fatupari?” “Ular besar gila.” “Jadi itulah Fatupari. Aku dan Bagarisa pernah bunuh satu—dan makan.”

ad8e8f4b6508.en: Eiri's eyes well up. "Everyone's hiding secrets from me! This isn't fair! FINE! Do what you want! I'm going back to the castle." As she leaves, the pillow flies, and Sora hugs her from behind. "I'm sorry!"
ad8e8f4b6508.t: Mata Eiri bergenang. “Semua orang berahsia dengan aku! Tak adil! OKEY! Buat apa korang nak! Aku balik istana.” Ketika dia beredar, bantal melayang, dan Sora memeluknya dari belakang. “Maafkan aku!”

ae274901ef0d.en: Clodoveu: "The den's a ways off. First we walk half a day to our hidden wagon, take it to the next hideout, then walk about a quarter timehunk." "Are all the teams there?" "We rarely see the other teams. We only go back to the den to report and grab the next quest." "So what was your current quest? Killing me?"
ae274901ef0d.t: Clodoveu: “Sarang tu agak jauh. Mula-mula kita jalan setengah hari ke gerabak tersembunyi kita, bawa ke tempat persembunyian seterusnya, kemudian jalan lebih kurang suku timehunk.” “Semua pasukan ada di sana?” “Kami jarang jumpa pasukan lain. Kami cuma balik ke sarang untuk lapor dan ambil misi seterusnya.” “Jadi apa misi korang sekarang? Bunuh aku?”

ae6603b7662c.en: Maiara wins the final round. Eori throws down her pieces, downs her drink and slams the cup. "How can you live like this? This is too boring!"
ae6603b7662c.t: Maiara memenangi pusingan akhir. Eori mencampak buah permainannya, meneguk minumannya dan menghempas cawan. “Macam mana kau boleh hidup macam ni? Bosan gila!”

aeefef50cfac.en: Eori slams the door and points at them. "Harry is your fault! FIX IT!—" Neferteri's eyes widen: Eori seems about to say what she has feared she would say. Huneo steps in between. "THIS IS NOT HOW YOU TREAT THE QUEEN!" Itagiba stands. "Huneo, it's fine. We understand." "Absolutely not! This is unacceptable! Eori! As my second apprentice, I demand you apologize RIGHT NOW!"
aeefef50cfac.t: Eori menghempas pintu dan menuding mereka. “Harry salah korang! BETULKAN!—” Mata Neferteri terbeliak: Eori seolah-olah hendak mengatakan apa yang ditakutinya selama ini. Huneo masuk di tengah-tengah. “BUKAN BEGINI CARA MELAYAN PERMAISURI!” Itagiba berdiri. “Huneo, tak apa. Kami faham.” “Sama sekali tidak! Ini tidak boleh diterima! Eori! Sebagai perantis kedua saya, saya menuntut kau minta maaf SEKARANG JUGA!”

b1657bc6488b.en: He pulls out, slaps her ass and walks out. Katsuki just stands there, waiting for something. Anything.
b1657bc6488b.t: Lelaki itu menarik keluar, menampar punggungnya dan keluar. Katsuki hanya berdiri di situ, menunggu sesuatu. Apa saja.

b2eb8b22a8fc.en: He falls forward, every breath leaving him more breathless, and slumps to the side. Another ghostly figure appears with a two-handed weapon and studies him. He barely lifts a heavy hand: he wants to kill it, but he can't. He whimpers in agony, closer to death with every breath.
b2eb8b22a8fc.t: Dia jatuh ke depan, setiap nafas membuatnya lebih sesak, dan terkulai ke sisi. Satu lagi susuk seperti hantu muncul dengan senjata dua tangan dan mengamatinya. Dia hampir tidak mampu mengangkat tangan yang berat: dia mahu membunuhnya, tetapi tidak boleh. Dia merengek dalam derita, semakin dekat dengan kematian dengan setiap nafas.

b38275b7de2d.en: Yacamim sits back down and slams her mug so hard it dings both the mug and the table. "Hey, you two! Gonna pay for that, or do you want someone to teach you a lesson?" A big man, not unlike Hiromi but much older, comes out of the corner. They square up, fists thirsting for blood, and at the last second do the Darfaries greeting.
b38275b7de2d.t: Yacamim duduk semula dan menghempas kolenya begitu kuat hingga kole dan meja itu kemik. “Hoi, korang berdua! Nak bayar ke, atau nak orang ajar korang?” Seorang lelaki besar, tidak jauh beza dengan Hiromi tetapi jauh lebih tua, keluar dari sudut. Mereka bersemuka, penumbuk dahagakan darah, dan pada saat akhir melakukan salam Darfaries.

b92819966b65.en: Clodoveu raises his weapon; Harry closes his eyes, ready to die again
b92819966b65.t: Clodoveu mengangkat senjatanya; Harry memejamkan mata, bersedia mati lagi

ba8d2785ef50.en: He injures one, but the other kills him. This happens before the prologue of Book 1 (see the Webcomic).
ba8d2785ef50.t: Dia mencederakan seorang, tetapi yang seorang lagi membunuhnya. Ini berlaku sebelum prolog Buku 1 (lihat Webcomic).

bbe2e042a0d6.en: "Then get the fuck out!" "It seems you didn't hear the verdict, so I'll repeat it: you're my second apprentice now, which means you'll do my bidding. Report to the castle lab right now to develop new nari gels." "I'M NOT YOUR BITCH! FUCK OFF!" "Guards, arrest her for contempt." Eori fights the guards and loses. Pinned to the floor, she sees Neferteri peeking from the hallway. "Fucking bitch. You'll pay for this."
bbe2e042a0d6.t: “Kalau macam tu berambus, celaka!” “Nampaknya kau tak dengar keputusan itu, jadi saya ulang: kau perantis kedua saya sekarang, yang bermakna kau akan ikut perintah saya. Lapor diri ke makmal istana sekarang juga untuk membangunkan nari gel baharu.” “AKU BUKAN JALANG KAU! BLAH LA!” “Pengawal, tangkap dia kerana menghina.” Eori melawan pengawal dan kalah. Tersepit di lantai, dia nampak Neferteri mengintai dari lorong. “Jalang celaka. Kau akan bayar untuk ni.”

bcb3dc75fda3.en: Wilson: "Something less boring would be nice." Clodoveu: "Big words from someone shitting himself just yesterday." "Nah. I wasn't shitting myself, I was lightening my load to run faster." He laughs. Clodoveu takes him seriously. "That's an interesting strategy. Harry, you could use that to pick up your pace." Harry thinks about it, and shakes his head. "I'll pass."
bcb3dc75fda3.t: Wilson: “Sesuatu yang kurang membosankan pun bagus juga.” Clodoveu: “Cakap besar daripada orang yang terberak semalam.” “Tak. Aku tak terberak, aku ringankan muatan supaya boleh lari lebih laju.” Dia ketawa. Clodoveu menganggapnya serius. “Strategi yang menarik. Harry, kau boleh guna tu untuk percepatkan langkah.” Harry memikirkannya, dan menggeleng. “Tak apalah.”

bcf4232871f7.en: The sisters flee the bandits in the rain
bcf4232871f7.t: Adik-beradik itu lari daripada penyamun dalam hujan

bd8c6ea3bf01.en: Eori and Maiara, drinks in hand, play Minari in the castle parlor
bd8c6ea3bf01.t: Eori dan Maiara, minuman di tangan, bermain Minari di ruang tamu istana

bd8e3b549c5e.en: Harry: "Can I ask why you gave me that nari bulking-up gel?" "So you can carry weight for us!" He finishes the haircut. "Now it's perfect! Say, wanna go wrestle outside before we shower?" Harry looks at Wilson, then at Clodoveu, and feels a choking atmosphere coming from the latter. "Nooo?" "That's too bad. Wilson?" Wilson laughs nervously. "Fuuuuck no. I ain't falling for that again." "What? It was purely an accident that I got hard." "I dunno about that. I'm just gonna go to sleep instead." "All right. Night!"
bd8e3b549c5e.t: Harry: “Boleh aku tanya kenapa korang bagi aku gel nari pembesar badan tu?” “Supaya kau boleh angkat barang untuk kami!” Dia menghabiskan potongan rambut. “Sekarang dah sempurna! Eh, nak bergusti kat luar sebelum kita mandi?” Harry memandang Wilson, kemudian Clodoveu, dan merasakan suasana mencekik datang daripada yang kedua. “Taaak?” “Sayang sekali. Wilson?” Wilson ketawa gugup. “Taaak nak, celaka. Aku takkan tertipu lagi.” “Apa? Memang betul-betul kebetulan aku keras masa tu.” “Entahlah. Aku tidur je la.” “Okey. Selamat malam!”

c02578ef85a4.en: The cold rain feels like ice cubes trying to pierce his skin. The fire on his fingertips is his only salvation, until a gust of wind breaks his concentration and puts it out. He's shaking too much to light it again; the bitter cold takes over his mind every time. Wozen eyes watch from the background.
c02578ef85a4.t: Hujan sejuk terasa seperti ketulan ais cuba menembusi kulitnya. Api di hujung jarinya satu-satunya penyelamat, sehingga sehembus angin memecahkan tumpuannya dan memadamkannya. Dia menggigil terlalu kuat untuk menyalakannya lagi; sejuk yang pedih menguasai mindanya setiap kali. Mata Wozen memerhati dari belakang.

c086ee600a14.en: He stands silent for a moment, body frozen, eyes paralyzed, until a twitch in his eyes and hands breaks the stillness. He cracks his neck and stands face to face with Harry. Pure terror runs up Harry's spine; he can't react to such overwhelming power. "Show me."
c086ee600a14.t: Dia berdiri diam seketika, badan kaku, mata lumpuh, sehingga kedutan di mata dan tangannya memecahkan kesunyian. Dia meletupkan lehernya dan berdiri bersemuka dengan Harry. Kengerian tulen menjalar naik tulang belakang Harry; dia tidak dapat bertindak balas terhadap kuasa yang begitu dahsyat. “Tunjukkan.”

c27354012307.en: "Selling yourself to a scientist? Is that what people do?" "Could be. Care to tell me how you got this Bagarisa power?" Harry hesitates: he sees Eiri telling him not to say anything, pinky out. Anger wins, and he nods.
c27354012307.t: “Jual diri kepada saintis? Orang buat macam tu ke?” “Mungkin. Nak cerita macam mana kau dapat kuasa Bagarisa ni?” Harry teragak-agak: dia nampak Eiri menyuruhnya jangan cakap apa-apa, jari kelingking terjulur. Kemarahan menang, dan dia mengangguk.

c486223c4c5f.en: Marcus sits across from Harry, eating Bagarisa jerky and provoking him. Harry, gripping his coffee, wants to bash that smirk in like nobody's business; Clodoveu watches; Wilson is oblivious, picking his nose, his mind far away.
c486223c4c5f.t: Marcus duduk bertentangan Harry, makan dendeng Bagarisa dan memprovokasinya. Harry, menggenggam kopinya, mahu menghancurkan senyuman sinis itu sepuas hati; Clodoveu memerhati; Wilson tidak sedar apa-apa, mengorek hidung, fikirannya jauh melayang.

c4e2bdaf4f31.en: Harry wakes up sweating, Bagarisas sleeping all over him
c4e2bdaf4f31.t: Harry bangun berpeluh, Bagarisa tidur bertindih di atasnya

c5353d7c6591.en: Water flies, soaking both Marcus and Harry. "What the fuck is wrong with you, you fucking faggot?" "Marcus—" Marcus grabs a fistful of Clodoveu's chest hair. "What the fuck! Don't say my name in front of this fucker!" A punch from Clodoveu knocks out a bunch of Marcus's teeth and sends him flying across the room. Clodoveu scratches at the bald patch on his chest as the hair grows back. "Anyway."
c5353d7c6591.t: Air melayang, membasahi Marcus dan Harry. “Apa celaka masalah kau, pondan celaka?” “Marcus—” Marcus mencekak segenggam bulu dada Clodoveu. “Apa celaka! Jangan sebut nama aku depan bangsat ni!” Satu tumbukan Clodoveu merontokkan beberapa batang gigi Marcus dan menghantarnya terbang ke seberang bilik. Clodoveu menggaru tompok botak di dadanya ketika bulu itu tumbuh semula. “Apa-apa pun.”

c5c985c9360d.en: "Harry." "From where?" "Sanbi—Kingdom." Marcus lets go. "Sanbi my ass. You're a Hifuna beast." Wilson: "Waaaaaaattt! For real?" Harry, head throbbing: "Haaaaaa?" "Don't 'ha' me! You're lying! You two, figure this fucker out while I turn the Bagarisas on the spit. I want to know where that old fat bitch went." Marcus leaves.
c5c985c9360d.t: “Harry.” “Dari mana?” “Sanbi—Kerajaan.” Marcus melepaskan. “Sanbi kepala bapak kau. Kau Hifuna beast.” Wilson: “Haaaaaaaa? Betul ke?” Harry, kepala berdenyut: “Haaaaaa?” “Jangan ‘ha’ aku! Kau tipu! Korang berdua, korek siapa celaka ni sementara aku pusing Bagarisa atas pemanggang. Aku nak tahu ke mana perempuan tua gemuk jalang tu pergi.” Marcus beredar.

c63fc0e0a84e.en: Chapter 2 - An offer hard to swallow.

c75f3ce654e1.en: She goes through his pockets: 35 Pearls, and a single Amethyst in his ball pouch. "This won't even get me through two weeks, let alone hire someone to get her! Dammit! Why did you have to give up everything? We were so close!"
c75f3ce654e1.t: Dia menyelongkar poketnya: 35 Pearl, dan sebiji Amethyst dalam kantung bolanya. “Ni pun tak cukup untuk dua minggu, apa lagi nak upah orang ambil dia! Celaka! Kenapa kau kena lepaskan segalanya? Kita dah dekat sangat!”

c83eeac5a6cb.en: Harry #10 meets Kozaku, who sits silently, overseeing the bandits
c83eeac5a6cb.t: Harry #10 bertemu Kozaku, yang duduk diam, mengawasi para penyamun

c8a8fb369ae0.en: The maids in Sora's dormitory room, all clean and girly
c8a8fb369ae0.t: Para pembantu rumah dalam bilik asrama Sora, semuanya bersih dan feminin

cb2272b124c8.en: The sisters walk the road at sunrise, Katsumi pulling Katsuki along
cb2272b124c8.t: Adik-beradik itu berjalan di jalan ketika matahari terbit, Katsumi menarik Katsuki bersama

cb625f670f55.en: Sticks and stones are encrusted in his soles like jewels, painful, macabre ones. Pulling one out feels like a needle through the bone, followed by a warm, pounding tickle as his accelerated healing kicks in: he laughs, cries and agonizes all at once. He cleans his feet one stone at a time, but the healing gets slower with each one.
cb625f670f55.t: Ranting dan batu terbenam di tapak kakinya seperti permata, permata yang menyakitkan dan mengerikan. Mencabut satu terasa seperti jarum menembusi tulang, diikuti geli hangat yang berdenyut apabila penyembuhan pantasnya bermula: dia ketawa, menangis dan menderita serentak. Dia membersihkan kakinya satu batu demi satu batu, tetapi penyembuhannya semakin perlahan dengan setiap satu.

cce95e23cf1e.en: Three full beers slap onto the table. Yacamim looks doubtful, but drowns it in a large beer. Hiromi: "When did your sister get that frisky?" Yacamim spit-takes all over the table and chokes, turning heads in the bar. "You fucking cunt. Why would you put it like that?"
cce95e23cf1e.t: Tiga kole bir penuh dihempas ke atas meja. Yacamim nampak ragu, tetapi menenggelamkannya dalam sekole besar bir. Hiromi: “Bila adik kau jadi gatal macam tu?” Yacamim tersembur bir ke seluruh meja dan tercekik, membuat orang di bar menoleh. “Kau pantat celaka. Kenapa kau cakap macam tu?”

ce65d95e4ea9.en: The ghostly white figure takes off running. It's thrilling! He chases it with all his strength, cocks both arms back, then forward, and unleashes a torrent of flame that lights up the sky. His ankles give out and he falls on all fours; ahead, a faint white figure wavers like a dying light.
ce65d95e4ea9.t: Susuk putih seperti hantu itu memecut lari. Mendebarkan! Dia mengejarnya sekuat tenaga, menarik kedua-dua lengan ke belakang, kemudian ke depan, dan melepaskan semburan api yang menerangi langit. Buku lalinya menyerah dan dia jatuh merangkak; di depan, susuk putih yang samar beralun seperti cahaya yang hampir padam.

cecc565a8774.en: "Harry? I love him. I want him!" "The search quest has been created." "Thank you, Mom. What will happen to the contracts I signed?" "I'll deal with them. Nina, shall we all put our disguises on and go back to the castle?" "Yeahhh!" A crying Nina joins in a group hug.
cecc565a8774.t: “Harry? Aku cintakan dia. Aku nak dia!” “Misi pencarian sudah dibuat.” “Terima kasih, Mak. Apa jadi dengan kontrak-kontrak yang aku tandatangan?” “Bonda akan uruskan. Nina, jom kita semua pakai penyamaran dan balik ke istana?” “Yeayyy!” Nina yang menangis menyertai pelukan berkumpulan.

cf82e57ab0b6.en: "Good! Now, where are your experiment journals?" "It's all in my head! I don't write it down for the likes of you to steal!" "Then you'll write it all down, after the inventory." She grabs a bottle to throw, and an arrow pierces her forearm, shattering the bone. Her arm falls limp, the bone exposed; she screams in pain, agony and rage.
cf82e57ab0b6.t: “Bagus! Sekarang, mana jurnal eksperimen kau?” “Semuanya dalam kepala aku! Aku tak tulis supaya orang macam kau boleh curi!” “Kalau begitu kau akan tulis semuanya, selepas inventori.” Dia mencapai sebotol untuk dibaling, dan sebatang anak panah menembusi lengan bawahnya, menghancurkan tulang. Lengannya terkulai, tulang terdedah; dia menjerit kesakitan, derita dan marah.

d0aa4d97fe51.en: A bandit: "Hey, you! Stop fucking around and get to work!" She picks the flowers faster, without a word. He puts a hand on her shoulder and breathes in her ear. "What's your plan for tonight? Gonna try going out the window again? Try something new, and I'll do the same, and fuck you from behind all night long."
d0aa4d97fe51.t: Seorang penyamun: “Hoi, kau! Berhenti main-main dan buat kerja!” Dia memetik bunga lebih cepat, tanpa sepatah kata. Lelaki itu meletakkan tangan di bahunya dan menghembus nafas di telinganya. “Apa rancangan kau malam ni? Nak cuba keluar tingkap lagi? Cuba benda baharu, dan aku pun buat sama, dan main kau dari belakang sepanjang malam.”

d0bcb9bcb02d.en: Harry #10, jacked up, eats chicken jerky drenched in Black Honey
d0bcb9bcb02d.t: Harry #10, berotot sasa, makan dendeng ayam bersimbah Black Honey

d0d4d064686d.en: A dream: a Bagarisa man fights two adventurers
d0d4d064686d.t: Mimpi: seorang lelaki Bagarisa melawan dua orang pengembara

d0e0e0663a9b.en: Namia apologizes: she was so sure of her findings when she first observed Arukia. Neferteri: "I don't doubt your expertise, Namia. Arukia was simply too clever at disguising who she truly was."
d0e0e0663a9b.t: Namia meminta maaf: dia begitu yakin dengan penemuannya ketika mula-mula memerhati Arukia. Neferteri: “Beta tidak meragui kepakaranmu, Namia. Arukia cuma terlalu bijak menyamarkan siapa dirinya yang sebenar.”

d3b6ea1cf087.en: The books and things inside are deteriorated. The only map he finds doesn't show where he is. He sighs, spots a fishing rod, and goes to sleep.
d3b6ea1cf087.t: Buku-buku dan barang di dalamnya sudah rosak. Satu-satunya peta yang dijumpainya tidak menunjukkan di mana dia berada. Dia mengeluh, ternampak joran pancing, dan pergi tidur.

d420da1842f5.en: Clodoveu flies at Harry fist first (like Maiara did); Harry blocks with crossed arms
d420da1842f5.t: Clodoveu terbang ke arah Harry dengan penumbuk di depan (seperti Maiara); Harry menahan dengan lengan bersilang

d61215b2f387.en: Kibe: "That's it. You can all go now." The captains stand up, refusing to leave. "What? We're done with the city safety debriefing."
d61215b2f387.t: Kibe: “Itu saja. Korang semua boleh pergi.” Para kapten berdiri, enggan beredar. “Apa? Kita dah habis taklimat keselamatan bandar.”

d64c389f9ac9.en: Neferteri is playing a bit coy (cu doce, as they say in Portuguese): she senses Huneo isn't someone she can easily control. She changes her mind in Book 7, once she learns how to unleash the bull in the china shop, minimizing the damage while he gets her dirty work done without her getting her hands dirty.
d64c389f9ac9.t: Neferteri sedang jual mahal sedikit (cu doce, seperti kata orang Portugis): dia dapat rasa Huneo bukan orang yang mudah dia kawal. Dia berubah fikiran dalam Buku 7, sebaik dia belajar cara melepaskan lembu jantan di kedai pinggan mangkuk, meminimumkan kerosakan sementara lelaki itu membuat kerja kotornya tanpa dia mengotorkan tangannya sendiri.

d6c38c4309a7.en: Huneo launches into a long speech, until the crowd cuts him off: "Sanbi shit! Are you gonna talk all day or what? I got a fish to gut!" He skips several pages. "Thank you all, and—and I hope to earn your trust." The crowd claps, erratically but energetically, not quite sure what to make of this uptight Forway lookalike.
d6c38c4309a7.t: Huneo memulakan ucapan panjang, sehingga orang ramai memotongnya: “Demi jiwa tua Sanbi! Kau nak bercakap sepanjang hari ke apa? Aku ada ikan nak disiang!” Dia melangkau beberapa muka surat. “Terima kasih semua, dan—dan saya harap dapat meraih kepercayaan kalian.” Orang ramai bertepuk tangan, tidak menentu tetapi bersemangat, tidak begitu pasti apa nak dibuat dengan pelanduk dua serupa Forway yang kaku ini.

d781df849777.en: "Why didn't you tell me?" "I still don't know who would do such a thing to Harry and Sinoi, or why. I wanted to talk to you once I had something tangible, but I'm afraid I haven't found anything of value yet." "Then issue a search quest!" "And put his only possible excuse in jeopardy? If I don't invoke the clauses of our contract, Sinoi has a chance to convince whoever captured him that he has no ties to us."
d781df849777.t: “Kenapa tuanku tak beritahu saya?” “Beta masih tidak tahu siapa yang akan buat begitu kepada Harry dan Sinoi, atau kenapa. Beta mahu bercakap denganmu sebaik beta ada sesuatu yang nyata, tetapi beta khuatir beta belum menemui apa-apa yang bernilai.” “Kalau begitu keluarkan misi pencarian!” “Dan membahayakan satu-satunya alasan yang mungkin dia ada? Jika beta tidak menggunakan fasal kontrak kita, Sinoi ada peluang meyakinkan sesiapa yang menangkapnya bahawa dia tiada kaitan dengan kita.”

d897627cb50b.en: Chapter 1 - Sanbi’s Four Power Players XX, XX 1040 meeting.
d897627cb50b.t: Bab 1 - Mesyuarat Empat Pemain Kuasa Sanbi XX, XX 1040.

da528f403398.en: Kibe: "You're still finding his journals?" Huneo: "The guard captains raided a personal stash of his at the Forway scientific school."
da528f403398.t: Kibe: “Kau masih jumpa jurnal dia?” Huneo: “Para kapten pengawal menyerbu simpanan peribadinya di sekolah sains Forway.”

db431c6b71ee.en: Harry feels all his muscles bulge, and I mean all of them. The chicken jerky with Black Honey tastes amazing. Clodoveu, finishing Harry's haircut, looks interested; Wilson tries not to laugh, and fails. "So that's the real reason you wanted him on the team." Clodoveu smiles. "Hey! I like twinks and Woolies alike." (Woolies: slang for burly, hairy men.)
db431c6b71ee.t: Harry rasa semua ototnya membengkak, dan aku maksudkan semuanya. Dendeng ayam dengan Black Honey rasa luar biasa. Clodoveu, yang sedang menghabiskan potongan rambut Harry, nampak berminat; Wilson cuba tidak ketawa, dan gagal. “Jadi itulah sebab sebenar kau nak dia dalam pasukan.” Clodoveu tersenyum. “Hei! Aku suka twink dan Woolie sama rata.” (Woolie: slanga untuk lelaki sasa berbulu.)

dbbe2bf82bb6.en: "Going by the contract alone, you're delivering double the minimum required. But this is no longer about our contract; it's about your relationship with Harry."
dbbe2bf82bb6.t: “Berdasarkan kontrak semata-mata, anakanda menyerahkan dua kali ganda jumlah minimum yang diperlukan. Tetapi ini bukan lagi tentang kontrak kita; ini tentang hubungan anakanda dengan Harry.”

dbc1ac158132.en: Eiri comes in and closes the door. "Are you guys abusing Sora?" Itanema: "C'mon now. This is your chance." Sora shakes her head into the pillow. "What's this all about?" "Argh. I guess I'll have to be the villain, then—I don't want this anymore. You're—"
dbc1ac158132.t: Eiri masuk dan menutup pintu. “Korang buli Sora ke?” Itanema: “Sudahlah. Ini peluang kau.” Sora menggeleng ke dalam bantal. “Apa semua ni?” “Argh. Rasanya aku kena jadi orang jahat, kalau macam tu—aku tak nak lagi semua ni. Kau—”

dbea584ae58e.en: Harry #8-B stumbles onto an abandoned shack

dc06f6b4023c.en: Harry #9-B, soaked, watches the two bandits make more cold water
dc06f6b4023c.t: Harry #9-B, basah kuyup, memerhati dua penyamun itu membuat lebih banyak air sejuk

de0da974186f.en: Eiri asks for a day off to see Coema off. Neferteri can't stand hearing the name; she grips her badge and tells Eiri not to bring Coema here.
de0da974186f.t: Eiri meminta cuti sehari untuk menghantar Coema pergi. Neferteri tidak tahan mendengar nama itu; dia menggenggam lencananya dan memberitahu Eiri jangan bawa Coema ke sini.

de0e9ae7af70.en: Eiri: "This would even explain why Neferteri demanded that all of Harry's letters go through her. I really want to tell Itagiba, but if I do, it might just crumble the entire guild." She stands. "Girls. This conversation dies here, with us. Don't tell anyone else, or we'll be in a world of trouble."
de0e9ae7af70.t: Eiri: “Ini malah menjelaskan kenapa Neferteri tuntut semua surat Harry melalui dia. Aku betul-betul nak beritahu Itagiba, tapi kalau aku buat, mungkin seluruh persatuan runtuh.” Dia berdiri. “Gadis-gadis. Perbualan ni mati di sini, dengan kita. Jangan beritahu sesiapa, atau kita akan dalam masalah besar.”

debe7caede34.en: Harry #7-A eats a fruit the Bagarisas scream at him about
debe7caede34.t: Harry #7-A memakan buah yang membuat Bagarisa menjerit kepadanya

dfe33e38de48.en: Harry #8-C fights a bigger animal near sundown
dfe33e38de48.t: Harry #8-C melawan haiwan yang lebih besar menjelang senja

e04d41fced19.en: Aurora clears her throat. "Princesses?" They let go and sit down in unison, covered in a blanket of shame, looking away from each other. "Princess Eori, you were so busy with your nari gels that you never noticed Maiara's accomplishments in Homeegg. She's the glue that holds the Sanbi Kingdom team together."
e04d41fced19.t: Aurora berdehem. “Tuan-tuan Puteri?” Mereka melepaskan dan duduk serentak, diselubungi selimut malu, memandang ke arah lain. “Puteri Eori, tuan puteri terlalu sibuk dengan nari gel sampai tak pernah perasan pencapaian Maiara dalam Homeegg. Dialah gam yang menyatukan pasukan Kerajaan Sanbi.”

e05add853200.en: She punches things, breaks things, smashes things, then curls up by the bed, crying. "I just wanted Harry!" A knock. "Leave me the fuck alone!"
e05add853200.t: Dia menumbuk barang, memecahkan barang, menghancurkan barang, kemudian meringkuk di tepi katil, menangis. “Aku cuma nak Harry!” Ketukan. “Jangan kacau aku, celaka!”

e53ea5c1b0bf.en: "Princess—daughter Eori. My daughter Eori. When I said Harry would be under your care, I meant using him as a tool to further our scientific knowledge, and our kingdom into the future."
e53ea5c1b0bf.t: “Tuan Puteri—anakanda Eori. Anakanda beta, Eori. Bila beta kata Harry akan di bawah jagaan anakanda, beta maksudkan menggunakannya sebagai alat untuk memajukan ilmu sains kita, dan kerajaan kita ke masa depan.”

e6ade5f6b103.en: Shady Black Magina riders on Eguas
e6ade5f6b103.t: Penunggang Black Magina yang mencurigakan di atas Egua

e6c11a250c86.en: Nina comes in holding a contract, smiling ear to ear, climbs onto a chair and, chest puffed out, unrolls it, trying to sound like a guard reading a sentence: "With the afore—mentioned clause—sules, Queen Neferteri shall terminate the contract, and the research funding."
e6c11a250c86.t: Nina masuk memegang sebuah kontrak, tersenyum lebar, memanjat ke atas kerusi dan, dengan dada membusung, membuka gulungannya, cuba berbunyi seperti pengawal membaca hukuman: “Dengan fa—sal-fasal yang ter—sebut di atas, Permaisuri Neferteri akan menamatkan kontrak, dan dana penyelidikan.”

e7377d9733ab.en: Death squeals outside; Harry pictures the Bagarisas dying. He grabs the arrow and rips it out in one swing, blood splattering everywhere, coughs up the blood filling his lungs and stands. Rage overtakes him, and he screams from deep in his gut.
e7377d9733ab.t: Cicitan maut di luar; Harry membayangkan Bagarisa mati. Dia menggenggam anak panah itu dan merentapnya keluar sekali tarik, darah memercik ke mana-mana, membatukkan darah yang memenuhi paru-parunya dan berdiri. Kemarahan menguasainya, dan dia menjerit dari lubuk perutnya.

e76693f1758c.en: Clodoveu wears the same nari gel Arukia used to see in the dark. Harry: "So what do you guys even do?" "The usual. Stealing, sometimes kidnapping, mostly from the filthy rich. That's the Blue Wozens' motto." He shows his proof of membership. "The boss formed this bandit group a while ago, after some rich Forway families looked down on his family. They took advantage of him through contracts, until he realized he had a way out: flee the contract, and leech off the rich who once imprisoned him."
e76693f1758c.t: Clodoveu memakai nari gel yang sama yang digunakan Arukia untuk melihat dalam gelap. Harry: “Jadi apa sebenarnya korang buat?” “Biasa-biasa saja. Mencuri, kadang-kadang menculik, kebanyakannya daripada orang kaya celaka. Itulah moto Blue Wozens.” Dia menunjukkan bukti keahliannya. “Bos tubuhkan kumpulan penyamun ni dulu, selepas beberapa keluarga kaya Forway memandang rendah keluarganya. Mereka ambil kesempatan atas dia melalui kontrak, sampai dia sedar dia ada jalan keluar: lari daripada kontrak, dan hisap darah orang kaya yang pernah memenjarakannya.”

e7964a37e572.en: Kibe and Huneo at the ceremony
e7964a37e572.t: Kibe dan Huneo di upacara itu

e82a7387c182.en: Eiri pets Sora's head. I guess love does make people do all kinds of crazy shit— She stops in her tracks, remembering how pushy Neferteri was about getting Harry to sign the contract, and how much she put on the search quest. Did the Queen already know Eori loved Harry? But then why— "Oh crap! Harry and Eori were having a love affair this whole time!"
e82a7387c182.t: Eiri mengusap kepala Sora. Rasanya cinta memang buat orang buat macam-macam benda gila— Dia berhenti melangkah, teringat betapa memaksanya Neferteri supaya Harry menandatangani kontrak, dan berapa banyak yang dia letak untuk misi pencarian itu. Permaisuri dah tahu ke Eori cintakan Harry? Tapi kalau macam tu kenapa— “Alamak! Harry dan Eori bercinta selama ni!”

e85ac8f4c504.en: Harry #7-A shelters at the foot of a big tree as night and rain set in
e85ac8f4c504.t: Harry #7-A berlindung di kaki sebatang pokok besar ketika malam dan hujan tiba

e88037789ba9.en: Eori, alone in a room, tries to free herself
e88037789ba9.t: Eori, seorang diri dalam bilik, cuba melepaskan diri

e93b0d7f2059.en: She also wants them to look into Arukia's disappearance: the more she thinks about it, the more intertwined Arukia's actions seem. But they're to put their own safety above hers, since nobody knows what Arukia, or whoever controls her, really is.
e93b0d7f2059.t: Dia juga mahu mereka menyiasat kehilangan Arukia: semakin dia memikirkannya, semakin berkait tindakan Arukia nampaknya. Tetapi mereka perlu meletakkan keselamatan sendiri di atas keselamatannya, kerana tiada siapa tahu apa sebenarnya Arukia, atau sesiapa yang mengawalnya.

ea00dec5e74b.en: Ukim, the new maid who came after Arukia left, and the curious type, digs deeper: "Did Eori really say that? That's so sweet!" Sora shakes her head. "There's something wrong! I know it!" Itanema: "You guys only noticed now?" Everyone stops. "Why didn't you say anything?" "'Cause it wouldn't really change anything. Just connect the dots. It's that easy."
ea00dec5e74b.t: Ukim, pembantu rumah baharu yang datang selepas Arukia pergi, dan jenis yang ingin tahu, mengorek lebih dalam: “Eori betul-betul cakap macam tu? Sweetnya!” Sora menggeleng. “Ada yang tak kena! Aku tahu!” Itanema: “Korang baru perasan sekarang?” Semua orang terhenti. “Kenapa kau tak cakap apa-apa?” “Sebab tak ubah apa pun sebenarnya. Sambungkan saja titik-titiknya. Senang je.”

ea0297bad0d1.en: Eori jumps up. "I NEVER SAID I LOVED HIM!" The guards step forward; she clenches her fists and sits back down, holding back a sea of emotions. Neferteri raises a hand, the guards step back, and she lets the awkward silence thicken.
ea0297bad0d1.t: Eori melompat bangun. “AKU TAK PERNAH CAKAP AKU CINTAKAN DIA!” Pengawal melangkah ke depan; dia menggenggam penumbuk dan duduk semula, menahan lautan emosi. Neferteri mengangkat tangan, pengawal berundur, dan dia membiarkan kesunyian yang janggal itu semakin tebal.

ea5f1c87bd15.en: Clodoveu opens a bag of snacks with a huge smirk. "Right on. Tell me every single detail." Wilson sits too and reaches for a snack, until a look from Clodoveu stops him. "This better be spicy!" Harry, frozen, tells them everything he knows.
ea5f1c87bd15.t: Clodoveu membuka sebungkus snek dengan senyuman sinis yang lebar. “Bagus. Ceritakan setiap butiran.” Wilson duduk juga dan menghulur tangan ke snek, sehingga pandangan Clodoveu menghentikannya. “Baik cerita ni pedas!” Harry, kesejukan, menceritakan semua yang dia tahu.

eb16ea3684af.en: Sora and Eiri, out with the guards, hear Eori scream
eb16ea3684af.t: Sora dan Eiri, keluar bersama pengawal, mendengar Eori menjerit

ec85330874b5.en: Marcus spits out half-broken teeth, bleeding from his nose and mouth. "I don't want another faggot on my team." Wilson raises his hand, a tear in his eye. "I'm with Clodoveu. Harry's suffered enough." Marcus leaves. "Then you two can suck him off. I don't fucking care. Kozaku will put a stop to this."
ec85330874b5.t: Marcus meludah keluar gigi yang separuh patah, berdarah dari hidung dan mulut. “Aku tak nak seorang lagi pondan dalam pasukan aku.” Wilson mengangkat tangan, air mata bergenang. “Aku sokong Clodoveu. Harry dah cukup menderita.” Marcus beredar. “Kalau macam tu korang berdua boleh hisap dia. Aku tak peduli langsung. Kozaku akan hentikan semua ni.”

ee9605f8b934.en: Stab! Stab! Stab! The ghost desperately stabs him in the back. He lets out an ear-piercing scream, his hand flares, and the ghost sizzles. He runs out of fire, but doesn't let go of that spongy thing. He tries to pump out more, but his grip is going.
ee9605f8b934.t: Tikam! Tikam! Tikam! Hantu itu menikam belakangnya dengan terdesak. Dia melepaskan jeritan yang memekakkan telinga, tangannya menyala, dan hantu itu berdesis. Apinya habis, tetapi dia tidak melepaskan benda berspan itu. Dia cuba mengepam lebih banyak, tetapi genggamannya semakin hilang.

ef6d38fe423f.en: A hoarse voice: "I like 'em tight!" Thunder roars across the sky.
ef6d38fe423f.t: Suara serak: “Aku suka yang ketat!” Guruh berdentum di langit.

efbf557378a1.en: Sora and Aurora try to picture the dots and connect them, and can't. Itanema puts a hand to her mouth. "The walls say there's a love triangle between Arukia, Eori and Harry, and Harry dumped them both and disappeared with someone else." Aurora gasps and drops her tea; Sora is stuck in sheer disbelief. It clicks: all the time those three spent away from the castle, out of the public eye.
efbf557378a1.t: Sora dan Aurora cuba membayangkan titik-titik itu dan menyambungkannya, dan tidak boleh. Itanema menekup mulut. “Dinding-dinding cakap ada cinta tiga segi antara Arukia, Eori dan Harry, dan Harry tinggalkan kedua-duanya dan hilang dengan orang lain.” Aurora tersentak dan menjatuhkan tehnya; Sora terperangkap dalam rasa tidak percaya. Ia masuk akal: semua masa yang dihabiskan bertiga jauh dari istana, jauh dari mata umum.

f02af4af8c4c.en: "I gave you a fuckload of new nari gel! What about it?"
f02af4af8c4c.t: “Aku dah bagi bonda banyak gila nari gel baharu! Apa masalahnya?”

f213ceca3bf9.en: Near sundown, the Bagarisas find someone's remains not far from the shack and start chewing on them. Harry realizes it was a person and tells them to stop. The clothes are an older woman's. He calls inside, but no one answers.
f213ceca3bf9.t: Menjelang senja, Bagarisa menjumpai mayat seseorang tidak jauh dari pondok itu dan mula mengunyahnya. Harry sedar itu dulunya seorang manusia dan menyuruh mereka berhenti. Pakaiannya milik seorang wanita yang lebih tua. Dia memanggil ke dalam, tetapi tiada siapa menjawab.

f2b1a0f179ba.en: Neferteri hands her a map with X marks around Sanbi, Cruroland, Sundeath and Freeish. "Sinoi was helping Harry move around, while keeping a close eye on him. He disappeared at the same time as Harry."
f2b1a0f179ba.t: Neferteri menyerahkan sebuah peta bertanda X di sekitar Sanbi, Cruroland, Sundeath dan Freeish. “Sinoi membantu Harry bergerak, sambil memerhatinya dengan teliti. Dia hilang pada masa yang sama dengan Harry.”

f3f3786daa19.en: Eori works for Huneo, guards at the door, a guard captain at his side
f3f3786daa19.t: Eori bekerja untuk Huneo, pengawal di pintu, seorang kapten pengawal di sisinya

f71b004edf0a.en: Katsuki watches from the barred window

f9fdf9fee229.t: Harry #8-A memasak di tepi unggun api

fa3226bf4e4c.en: Chunks of meat and fur on a makeshift spit, a bloodied stone on the side. Disgusted, he eats it anyway, spitting out fur. The Bagarisas want some, so he gives them all of it, and they clean their plate.
fa3226bf4e4c.t: Ketulan daging dan bulu di atas pemanggang buatan sendiri, batu berlumuran darah di tepi. Jijik, dia makan juga, meludah keluar bulu. Bagarisa mahu sedikit, jadi dia beri semuanya kepada mereka, dan mereka licinkan pinggan.

fa747c82ad01.en: Neferteri with Morika, Namia and Posaqui
fa747c82ad01.t: Neferteri bersama Morika, Namia dan Posaqui

fa7d7c23eb38.en: "Harry." Itagiba says it just as the door is about to close, then smiles. "You want to see him, right?" Eori stops in the doorway, hiding her face. Neferteri lays a hand on her husband's strong arm. "At this rate, we'll have to cut unnecessary expenses in the coming weeks, and Harry's search quest is one of them." "Why?" "Simply because we're implementing Huneo's strategies to improve our kingdom."
fa7d7c23eb38.t: “Harry.” Itagiba menyebutnya tepat ketika pintu hampir tertutup, kemudian tersenyum. “Kau nak jumpa dia, kan?” Eori berhenti di ambang pintu, menyembunyikan wajahnya. Neferteri meletakkan tangan di lengan kuat suaminya. “Pada kadar ini, kita perlu memotong perbelanjaan yang tidak perlu dalam minggu-minggu akan datang, dan misi pencarian Harry salah satunya.” “Kenapa?” “Semata-mata kerana kita melaksanakan strategi Huneo untuk memajukan kerajaan kita.”

fb32b202048c.en: "HAAARRRRYYY!!!! I LLLLOOOOOVVEEE YOOOUU!" echoes through the bustling city night, and the city goes quiet as everyone tries to figure out what just happened.
fb32b202048c.t: “HAAARRRRYYY!!!! AKU CIIIINNNTAAAKAAAN KAAAUUU!” bergema di seluruh malam bandar yang sibuk, dan bandar itu senyap ketika semua orang cuba memahami apa yang baru berlaku.

fe802cdb219c.en: Harry feels the pressure of being near him. Clodoveu is his usual bluntly troglodyte self; Wilson mostly hides behind Clodoveu; Marcus crosses his arms, almost daring the boss to fight. "Loot?" "Some of it rotted, but we brought back everything we could. Plus, we found a fourth member." "Tsk," Marcus mutters.
fe802cdb219c.t: Harry merasakan tekanan berada dekat dengannya. Clodoveu dengan dirinya yang biasa, terus terang macam orang gua; Wilson kebanyakannya bersembunyi di belakang Clodoveu; Marcus memeluk tubuh, hampir mencabar bos untuk berlawan. “Rampasan?” “Sebahagiannya reput, tapi kami bawa balik semua yang boleh. Tambah pula, kami jumpa ahli keempat.” “Cis,” gumam Marcus.
